consequence.statement: Router rules without an explicit syntax are now interpreted with the v3 matcher syntax by default (e.g. Headers/HeadersRegexp renamed to Header/HeaderRegexp, PathPrefix no longer regex-based), so existing v2-style rules may match differently; v2 syntax is deprecated.
consequence.remediation: Migrate rules to the v3 syntax, or set defaultRuleSyntax to v2 for backward compatibility.

assertion.statement: The default router rule matcher syntax (static option `defaultRuleSyntax`) is now `v3` instead of the v2 syntax, and the v2 syntax is deprecated, with support to be removed in the next major version.
